title: Assistance system to support the nutritional and mobility status of older adults at risk of malnutrition and physical functional impairment - a randomized controlled trial
summary: In the AS-Tra RCT study, we are working with seniors (>=70 years) to develop a technical assistance system consisting of a measuring and training station and a corresponding app. With this system, it should be possible to independently monitor nutritional and mobility status and to train in a targeted manner. The aim is to investigate what effect the use of the assistance system has on walking speed (>+0.1 m/s) and protein intake, how the participants in the intervention group rate the use of the system and how effective its use is compared to the control group (standard care, without use of the assistance system).
conditions: Risk of malnutrition/evident malnutrition and/or restricted mobility

interventions.name: The participants in the intervention group (n=62) use the measuring and training station and a tablet with the corresponding app independently for an intervention period of 12 weeks. criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Risk of or evidence of malnutrition (MNA-LF<=23.5 points; weight loss >=3kg within the last 3 months; decreased BMI <23kg/m^2; decreased protein intake <0.8g/kg body weight) and or presence of one or more signs of impaired mobility (walking speed <0.8m/s; SPPB<8 points; Knee Extension Strength <0.4kg/kg body weight for men or 0.31kf/kg body weight for women) and you must be able to access the study rooms (barrier free)
Exclusion criteria:
Lack of ability to give consent; insufficient ability to understand the study content or the German language; unable to walk; severe visual impairments that do not allow independent operation of the components of the measuring and training station; presence of nutrition-associated diseases that cannot be covered by the app settings; pacemaker; advanced osteoporosis (grade 3); acute burn injuries/fractures in the forearm/wrist area
